changes: Root AGENTS.md is fully English, its current Proof-or-Stop guidance is reconciled against authoritative code and decisions, the old fix-everything rule is replaced by bounded severity-and-acceptance triage, and a reproducible audit plus verifier records the RED-to-GREEN proof including Claude CLI and Agy CLI participation.
usage: Open AGENTS.md for the current English operator guidance, inspect docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md for the evidence ledger, and rerun node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final.
expectedOutcome: The user sees a fully English root AGENTS.md whose active commands and lifecycle claims match the repository-local Proof-or-Stop implementation, with inspectable evidence for every corrected inconsistency.
actualTranscript: The live-smoke command exited 0 and reported 26/26 audit rows GREEN, 46/46 command cases PASS, zero Han, zero U+FFFD, zero non-ASCII residue, valid Claude/Agy provenance, and AGENTS_VERIFY FINAL GREEN.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference: the expected English, current, evidence-backed guidance matches the captured actual result.
limitations: External Claude and Agy transcripts are machine-local evidence; the audit records hashes and provenance but does not claim those files are portable. F-044 tracks an unrelated suspected medium identity-cutover baseline issue for a follow-up Story.
pitfalls: The first formal validation exposed one same-line legacy-label defect that propagated into five contract-test failures; it was fixed narrowly in DEV and all five plus the 120-command suite passed on rerun. The suite exceeds the phase command 15-minute watchdog, so standalone validate used the sanctioned raised budget before TEST reused the signed PASS.
